archetype_reasoning: RMM/PSA software requires intense authority, clarity, and precision. We are discarding standard SaaS blue and adopting a deep Obsidian black background, pure white data points, and tactical Violet/Cyan accents for high-visibility triggers and AI presence. This echoes Linear/Plain.com's hyper-functional, developer-centric aesthetic.

typography.headings_font: JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono (for ticket numbers and technical headers)
typography.body_font: Inter or IBM Plex Sans (highly legible geometric sans)

hierarchy.H1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight font-medium (Calm, not oversized)

rules: No generic 'Bold' for headers; use 'Medium' or 'Semibold' with tight tracking.
Use monospace for all metrics, IDs, IP addresses, and timers.

accents.primary: #8B5CF6 (Violet - for AI features and primary CTAs)
accents.secondary: #06B6D4 (Cyan - for active viewer/tech rings and live status)

rules: NO teal/green universally (use Cyan for active states).
Surface logic: Flat solid backgrounds with 1px border (`border-white/10`) for cards, no drop shadows on dark mode, use subtle 'Inner Glow' highlights.

list_view.concept: Virtualized, dense table-list hybrid inspired by Linear. No bulky cards per row.
list_view.structure: 1 row per ticket. Border-bottom only (`border-b border-white/5`). Hover state: `hover:bg-white/[0.02]`.
row_elements: Left Edge: Sticky priority dot (Red/Amber/Gray) or 2px left-border
Col 1: Checkbox (appears on row hover or if selected)
Col 6: Status Pill (Compact padding `px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px]`)
Col 7: Assignee Avatar + Active Viewers (overlapping circles with Cyan shimmer ring if active)
Col 8: SLA Timer / Age (Monospace, turns red if < 1h)
Right Edge: Quick action icons reveal on hover (Assign, Resolve, Menu)
list_view.grouping: Collapsible section headers (e.g., 'Today', 'SLA Breached', 'Waiting on Client') with count badges.

detail_view.concept: 3-Column layout to eliminate modal-fatigue and reduce clicking.
detail_view.col_1_left: Context Rail (20% width): Collapsible. Contains Client info, Asset Details, related tickets graph mini-view.
detail_view.col_2_center: Timeline & Conversation (50% width): Top shows 'AI Summarization & Triage'. Middle is sequential chronological thread of notes/emails/alerts. Bottom is composer (always visible, tab to switch internal vs public).
detail_view.col_3_right: Live Device & Workflow Rail (30% width): Burn-down bar, Status/Priority selectors, Live Device Cockpit (gauges, quick actions).
detail_view.hierarchy: Center column is brightest; left/right rails are slightly dimmed (`bg-[#0a0a0a]`) compared to center thread (`bg-[#121212]`).

workshop_jobs.card_design: Grid-based bento card (`grid-cols-1 gap-2`). Shows photo thumbnail, monospace ID, parts list inline tags, progress bar. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for cards to allow easy framer-motion dragging.

field_service.left_panel: Timeline of today's jobs (Scheduled, En-route, On-site).
field_service.right_panel: Map preview card, customer notify CTA, and 'Materials Used' quick-add.

missing_features_to_build: 1. Command Palette Inline Filter (Context-aware ⌘K on list view).
2. AI Ticket Summarization & Next Best Action strip at the top of detail view.
3. Sentiment Heatmap (Tiny red/yellow/green indicator on row based on text analysis).
4. Live Collaborative Cursors/Viewers (Real-time presence avatars with cyan glow).
5. Related Tickets Graph View (Node-graph in left rail).
6. Predicted SLA Close-Time ETA (Machine learning estimation display).
7. On-the-fly Automation Builder (Quick 'Create Rule' from ticket).
8. Mobile-Optimized Swipe Actions for list rows.
components_to_create: TicketRow.js (Highly dense, grid-based single row, replacing the bulky Card)
StatusPill.js (Strict color semantics, tiny uppercase mono text)
ActiveViewers.js (Overlapping avatars with Framer Motion enter animations and active cyan ring)
DeviceCockpit.js (Right-rail widget for RAM/CPU gauges using minimal SVGs or Recharts)
AICopilotStrip.js (Violet accented 'Next Best Action' and summary bar)
WorkshopKanbanBoard.js (Drag-drop context area with stage columns)
FieldServiceMap.js (Static/Mocked map view with route timeline)

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Row hover slightly lightens background (`hover:bg-white/[0.02]`) and reveals right-aligned quick actions.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Minimal. Use Framer Motion layout animations for Kanban reordering and list filtering. No bouncy effects. Keep it snappy (e.g., `duration: 0.15`).
motion_and_interactions.tabs: Linear-style compact tabs. No colored background. Underline indicator using `framer-motion` layoutId for smooth sliding.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT recreate the entire project. Extend the existing TicketsPage.jsx.
Preserve ALL existing data-testids and functionalities (like bulk select, routing, etc.).
Implement the 3-column detail view layout (Context Rail, Timeline, Device Cockpit) using CSS Grid.
Refactor the Ticket List to use the dense 'TicketRow' concept instead of Shadcn Cards.
Implement the 'Compact/Comfortable/Spacious' density toggle using React state, applying different padding classes to rows.
Inject the 'AICopilotStrip' into the Ticket Detail view as a prominent feature.
Ensure the UI matches the 'Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast)' palette: #0A0A0A background, white/10 borders, pure white text, Violet/Cyan accents.
For icons, prefer Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react (if installed) to maintain the linear, thin-line aesthetic.
